title: The maps below show Hunderstone town at present and a proposed plan for it
prompt: The maps below show Hunderstone town at present and a proposed plan for it. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features and comparisons where relevant.
guideHtml:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Road system (now vs proposed plan)
1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy hiện trạng hệ thống giao thông và kế hoạch phát triển trong tương lai của một khu vực.

→ Dạng: map – present vs future (proposed changes)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ:

  • road system / layout
  • now / proposed plan

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • plan → proposed development / future layout

Ví dụ:

The maps illustrate the current road layout and the proposed future development of the area.

3. Overview (ý chính)
  • Hệ thống đường sẽ được mở rộng đáng kể
  • Thêm nhiều tuyến đường mới và vòng xuyến (roundabouts)
  • Airfield sẽ bị thay thế bởi industrial estate
  • Kết nối giao thông được cải thiện, đặc biệt quanh town centre
  • Khu vực trở nên hiện đại và thuận tiện hơn cho lưu thông
4. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Hiện trạng (NOW)
  • A2 là tuyến đường chính chạy dọc phía bên trái
  • Có một roundabout kết nối với một con đường dẫn đến town centre
  • Railway chạy theo hướng Bắc–Nam, chia khu vực thành hai phần
  • Gas station nằm bên trái đường sắt
  • Airfield nằm ở phía trên bên trái
  • Town centre nằm bên phải, có ring road xung quanh

→ Ý: hệ thống đường còn đơn giản, kết nối hạn chế

BODY 2 – Kế hoạch tương lai (PROPOSED PLAN)
  • A2 vẫn giữ nhưng được kết nối với tuyến mới A4
  • A4 tạo thành một vòng lớn bao quanh khu vực
  • Thêm nhiều roundabouts, bao gồm một ở gần railway
  • Airfield bị thay thế bởi industrial estate
  • Xây thêm đường nối trực tiếp tới town centre
  • Ring road vẫn giữ nhưng được tích hợp tốt hơn

→ Ý: hệ thống trở nên phức tạp hơn và kết nối hiệu quả hơn

5. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be expanded → được mở rộng
  • be replaced by → được thay thế bởi
  • be constructed → được xây dựng
  • be connected to → được kết nối với
  • transport network → hệ thống giao thông
  • improve connectivity → cải thiện kết nối

The maps compare the current road system with a proposed redevelopment of the area.

Overall, the plan involves a major expansion of the road network, including new routes, roundabouts, and improved connections to the town centre, while the airfield will be replaced by an industrial estate.

At present, a single main road (A2) runs north–south, linking a roundabout near the airfield in the northwest to the town centre in the southeast. A railway line runs parallel to this road, with a gas station located nearby, and the town centre is surrounded by a small ring road.

In the proposed plan, the airfield will be redeveloped into an industrial estate connected to a new roundabout. Additional roundabouts will be introduced along the main route, and a new road (A4) will form a large loop around the area, improving access. The town centre will be linked to this expanded network and remain encircled by a ring road, while the railway and gas station will remain unchanged.
chartDescription:
TYPE: map/plan
TITLE: NOW / PROPOSED PLAN
UNITS/AXES: Not applicable. Compass rose: N (North), W (West), E (East), S (South).
SERIES/CATEGORIES:
NOW: Air field, Railway, Gas station, Build-up area ring road, Town Center, A2 (road).
PROPOSED PLAN: Industrial estate, Railway, Gas station, Build-up area ring road, Town Center, A2 (road), A4 (road), new blue road.
DATA:
NOW:
- A2 road: Runs from the bottom-left, northwards, then turns east to a roundabout, then continues north to the Air field.
- Air field: Located at the northern end of the A2 road.
- Railway: Runs vertically from north to south, east of the A2 road.
- Gas station: Located west of the railway, south of the main diagonal road.
- Main diagonal road (unlabelled but connected to A2): Runs southeast from the roundabout on A2, crosses the railway, and leads to the Town Center.
- Build-up area ring road: A short road segment forming a ring around the Town Center, connected to the diagonal road.
- Town Center: Located at the southeastern end of the diagonal road, within the build-up area ring road.

PROPOSED PLAN:
- A2 road: Runs from the bottom-left, northwards, then turns east to a roundabout, then continues north to the Industrial estate. It also extends south-east from the initial roundabout, becoming part of a new A4 road.
- Industrial estate: Located at the northern end of the A2 road, replacing the Air field.
- Railway: Runs vertically from north to south, east of the A2 road, with a new roundabout built on it.
- Gas station: Remains in the same location, west of the railway, south of the main diagonal road.
- Main diagonal road (unlabelled but connected to A2): Runs southeast from the roundabout on A2, now crosses the railway at a new roundabout, and leads to the Town Center.
- Build-up area ring road: A short road segment forming a ring around the Town Center, connected to the diagonal road.
- Town Center: Remains in the same location at the southeastern end of the diagonal road, within the build-up area ring road.
- A4 road: A new road that branches off the A2 in the southwest, runs east, then turns northeast to connect to the Town Center.
- New blue road: A new road that runs north-south along the eastern edge of the map, connecting to the Town Center via a short segment. It has a roundabout in the middle.
KEY FEATURES:
- The Air field is replaced by an Industrial estate in the north.
- A new road, A4, is introduced in the south, connecting the A2 to the Town Center.
- A new major road (blue) is added to the east of the Town Center, running north-south.
- A new roundabout is added where the main diagonal road crosses the railway.
- The A2 road is extended and re-routed in the south to connect with the new A4 road.
- The Gas station, Railway, Build-up area ring road, and Town Center remain in their original locations.
